This is the official benchmark for the paper Generative View Stitching (GVS), which enables collision-free camera-guided video generation for predefined trajectories, and presents a non-autoregressive alternative to video length extrapolation.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ndsong/gvs_benchmark.
evaluation_method: perceptual and reconstruction metrics (FID, LPIPS, PSNR, SSIM) and video metrics such as FVD; task‑specific collision/camera safety metrics for trajectory adherence
general_score_metric: FID (for perceptual quality) and FVD (for video fidelity)
reputation: Released by authors from MIT CSAIL / Runway ML and referenced in the view‑synthesis and video generation literature; adoption is growing in this research niche but not yet widespread.
